source_units.text: “Now I have come to show you the truth. Three kings have stood in opposition in Persia, and the fourth will become richer than all the others. When he grows strong through his wealth, he will rise against every king of the Greeks.
source_units.display_text: “Now I have come to show you the truth. Three kings have stood in opposition in Persia, and the fourth will become richer than all the others. When he grows strong through his wealth, he will rise against every king of the Greeks.

source_units.display_text: A powerful king will arise, exercise great lordship, and do whatever he wishes.

source_units.text: He will strengthen Egypt’s kingdom, and one of the rulers will overpower him and rule; his rule will be a great rule.
source_units.display_text: He will strengthen Egypt’s kingdom, and one of the rulers will overpower him and rule; his rule will be a great rule.

source_units.text: At the completion of years he will lead them, and the king of Egypt will enter the northern kingdom to make treaties. He will not prevail, for his arm will not establish strength; his arm and that of those traveling with him will grow numb, and he will remain until the appointed hours.
source_units.display_text: At the completion of years he will lead them, and the king of Egypt will enter the northern kingdom to make treaties. He will not prevail, for his arm will not establish strength; his arm and that of those traveling with him will grow numb, and he will remain until the appointed hours.

source_units.text: He will enter Egypt’s kingdom for days and return to his land,
source_units.display_text: He will enter Egypt’s kingdom for days and return to his land,

source_units.text: and so will his son. He will be provoked, gather an assembly of a great crowd, and enter against it, sweeping through. He will pass over, return, and be greatly provoked.
source_units.display_text: and so will his son. He will be provoked, gather an assembly of a great crowd, and enter against it, sweeping through. He will pass over, return, and be greatly provoked.

source_units.text: The king of Egypt will become angry and fight the king of the north, and the assembled force will be handed into his hands.
source_units.display_text: The king of Egypt will become angry and fight the king of the north, and the assembled force will be handed into his hands.

source_units.text: The king of the north will return and gather a city’s force larger than the first at the completion of a year’s appointed time. He will enter it against him with a great crowd and much money.
source_units.display_text: The king of the north will return and gather a city’s force larger than the first at the completion of a year’s appointed time. He will enter it against him with a great crowd and much money.

source_units.text: In those times designs will rise against the king of Egypt. He will rebuild the fallen things of your nation and arise to establish the prophecy, but they will stumble.
source_units.display_text: In those times designs will rise against the king of Egypt. He will rebuild the fallen things of your nation and arise to establish the prophecy, but they will stumble.

source_units.text: The king of the north will come, turn his spears, and take the fortified city. The arms of Egypt’s king will stand with his rulers, but he will have no strength to resist him.
source_units.display_text: The king of the north will come, turn his spears, and take the fortified city. The arms of Egypt’s king will stand with his rulers, but he will have no strength to resist him.

source_units.text: He will set his face to advance all his undertaking by force and make treaties with him. He will give him a daughter of a human to destroy her, but she will not obey and will not remain.
source_units.display_text: He will set his face to advance all his undertaking by force and make treaties with him. He will give him a daughter of a human to destroy her, but she will not obey and will not remain.

source_units.text: He will set his face toward the sea and take many. He will turn back the wrath of their reproach with an oath according to his reproach.
source_units.display_text: He will set his face toward the sea and take many. He will turn back the wrath of their reproach with an oath according to his reproach.

source_units.text: In his place will arise one easily despised, upon whom royal glory will not be bestowed. He will come suddenly; a king will prevail in his allotment.
source_units.display_text: In his place will arise one easily despised, upon whom royal glory will not be bestowed. He will come suddenly; a king will prevail in his allotment.

source_units.text: He will shatter the already-shattered arms before him.
source_units.display_text: He will shatter the already-shattered arms before him.

source_units.text: He will suddenly desolate a city and do what neither his fathers nor his fathers’ fathers did. He will give them plunder, spoils, and money and devise plans against the strong city, but his plans will be in vain.
source_units.display_text: He will suddenly desolate a city and do what neither his fathers nor his fathers’ fathers did. He will give them plunder, spoils, and money and devise plans against the strong city, but his plans will be in vain.

source_units.text: His strength and heart will be stirred against Egypt’s king with a great crowd. Egypt’s king will be provoked to war with an exceedingly strong crowd, but will not stand, because he will devise a design against him.
source_units.display_text: His strength and heart will be stirred against Egypt’s king with a great crowd. Egypt’s king will be provoked to war with an exceedingly strong crowd, but will not stand, because he will devise a design against him.

source_units.text: His anxieties will consume him and turn him away. He will pass through and sweep away, and many wounded will fall.
source_units.display_text: His anxieties will consume him and turn him away. He will pass through and sweep away, and many wounded will fall.

source_units.text: at the appointed time. He will enter Egypt, but it will not be as the first and the last.
source_units.display_text: at the appointed time. He will enter Egypt, but it will not be as the first and the last.

source_units.text: When they are crushed, they will gather a little strength. Many will assemble with them at a city, and many as in an allotment.
source_units.display_text: When they are crushed, they will gather a little strength. Many will assemble with them at a city, and many as in an allotment.

source_units.text: He will pay no heed to his fathers’ gods or to the desire of a woman, for he will be exalted in everything, and strong nations will be subject to him.
source_units.display_text: He will pay no heed to his fathers’ gods or to the desire of a woman, for he will be exalted in everything, and strong nations will be subject to him.

source_units.text: of cities he will act, and he will come into a strong fortification. With a foreign god, whom he may acknowledge, he will multiply glory, rule over him greatly, and apportion country as a gift.

source_units.text: At the hour of completion, Egypt’s king will clash with him. The king of the north will rage against him with chariots, many horses, and many ships, and enter Egypt’s country

source_units.text: and come into my country,
source_units.display_text: and come into my country,

source_units.text: and in Egypt’s country no one will be saved.
source_units.display_text: and in Egypt’s country no one will be saved.

source_units.text: A report from the east and north will disturb him, and he will go out in strong anger and with a sword to wipe out and kill many.
source_units.display_text: A report from the east and north will disturb him, and he will go out in strong anger and with a sword to wipe out and kill many.

source_units.text: Then he will set his tent between the seas and the mountain of the Holy One’s desire. The hour of his completion will come, and no one will help him.”
